title: 第9章 你可愿结拜第10章 七色莲子
content_zh:
花果山。
陆生皱眉道：
“上仙，我可以作证。”
“它们从未做过伤天害理之事。”
“可否放过它们？”
哪吒摇头：
“这些猴子，全都开启了灵智。”
“其中还有不少是炼精化气的小妖。”
“我乃天庭镇妖大将，镇妖降魔乃我神职。”
“我为何要放过他们？”
陆生眉头紧皱。
在他印象中。
哪吒似乎没有这么不讲情理。
他相信，对哪吒而言。
放过花果山猴群，只是顺手的事。
对方为何非要这么做呢？
突然！
陆生注意到了哪吒眼中的异色。
他灵光一闪！
试探！

对，没错！
哪吒应该是在试探自己！
可是……
自己只是一个资质不高的后天生灵。
哪吒为何要试探自己呢？
他可不认为，自己跟这位三太子有什么关系。
等等……
关系！
陆生脑海中，突然灵光一现！
哪吒在娘胎三年，一出世便被人称为“怪胎”
再看陆生自己，更是连娘都没有。
是从石头里蹦出来的！
在外人看来，自然也是“怪胎”
无疑！
想到这里。
陆生神色有些怪异。
这位“三太子”
，该不会是因自己的出身与其相仿。
才对自己另眼相看，利用猴群考验自己吧？
哪吒缓缓开口：

“想要我放过它们，也可以。”
content_en:
Huaguoshan.
Lu Sheng frowned and said:
"Exalted Immortal, I can testify."
"They have never done anything harmful."
"Can you let them go?"
Nezha shook his head:
"These monkeys have all opened up their spiritual intelligence."
"Many of them are little demons who have refined their energy."
"I am the general who suppresses demons in heaven, and it is my priestly duty to suppress demons and subjugate demons."
"Why should I let them go?"
Lu Sheng frowned.
in his mind.
Nezha didn't seem so unreasonable.
He believed that for Nezha.
Letting go of the monkeys in Huaguo Mountain was just a matter of course.
Why does the other party have to do this?
Sudden!
Lu Sheng noticed the strange color in Nezha's eyes.
He had a flash of inspiration!
Test!
Yes, that’s right!
Nezha should be testing himself!
But...
I am just an acquired creature with low qualifications.
Why would Nezha test himself?
He didn't think he had anything to do with the third prince.
Wait...
Relationship!
Suddenly, an idea came to Lu Sheng's mind!
Nezha was called a "freak" when he was born for three years in his mother's womb.
Looking at Lu Sheng himself, he doesn’t even have a mother.
It popped out of the stone!
In the eyes of outsiders, nature is also a "freak"
No doubt!
Think of this.
Lu Sheng looked a little strange.
This "Third Prince"
, could it be because his origin is similar to hers.
Then you look at yourself differently and use the monkeys to test yourself, right?
Nezha spoke slowly:
"If you want me to let them go, that's fine."
